notes: Amazon listing B0D13CT7NS (single) gives: 1 x 4-in-1 RGBW 15W LED, AC90-130V 60Hz (2-pack listing says AC90-240V), control DMX/remote/sound, modes sound/jump/gradual/strobe, item 6.3 x 4.53 x 6.3 in, 15.2 oz (0.43 kg); package 9 x 6.7 x 4.3 in, 2 lb. 2-pack listing B0DFWBWF9W lists 6.69 x 4.53 x 9.06 in / 1.9 lb for the pair. Beam angle is not published (rotating focus lens) -- 10 deg is a guess typical of LED pinspots. No manual found (manuals.plus search blocked, eBay 404); channel names are the venue console map (Dimmer/Strobe/Effect, R, G, B, W, Macro) and ranges are guesses. Amazon reviewer (Mark Plant, Apr 2025) reports 'dmx is not implemented properly, only channel six works' -- treat CH6 macro as possibly overriding CH1-5 on some units.
